library_entry.summary: Mercury's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 8 months 9 days) is one of the better parts of the period in every source: reputation, wealth, comforts, pilgrimage and religious activity, and gains through trade. BPHS makes it good when Mercury is in a kendra or trikona. When Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu, there are gains at the start and illness and failures later. As 2nd or 7th lord, Mercury brings bodily distress.
common_outcomes: prosperity, contentment, female company, favour from the ruler, victory and help from friends (Phaladeepika 21.49)
more happiness, wealth and fame; merit from piety; gains through agriculture and commerce (Jataka Parijata 18.124)
charitable works, wealth, birth of children, more knowledge, favour of superiors, general prosperity (Raman p. 261)
rare_outcomes: rajayoga or headship of a village (BPHS 57.9, 57.12)
bathing at Setu (Rameshwaram) on pilgrimage (BPHS 57.10, Sanskrit gloss)
illness from all three humours; trouble to siblings and children (Phaladeepika 21.49)

by_area.personality: Enthusiasm and bodily well-being when Mercury is well placed (BPHS 57.10); anxiety and fear in the middle and end when it is badly placed (BPHS 57.13).
by_area.career: Respect from the public, good reputation and rajayoga (BPHS 57.8-9); favour of superiors (Raman); failure in ventures later in the period if Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 57.13).
by_area.finance: Gain of wealth, conveyances (BPHS 57.8-9); wealth from trade, agriculture and commerce (Jataka Parijata 18.124; Sanskrit gloss of BPHS 57.11).
by_area.health: Bodily comfort when well placed (BPHS 57.10); disease in the middle and end when afflicted (BPHS 57.13); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.14); illness from the three humours (Phaladeepika 21.49).
by_area.relationships: Female company (Phaladeepika 21.49); birth of children (Raman).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family (BPHS 57.10); trouble to siblings and children (Phaladeepika 21.49); success to relatives (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religious sacrifices, pilgrimage, listening to Puranas, charity and food donation (BPHS 57.9-11); acts of piety and customary observances (Jataka Parijata 18.124; Raman).

strengtheners: Mercury in a kendra or trikona (BPHS 57.8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu (BPHS 57.12)
Mercury debilitated or combust (BPHS 57.12, Sanskrit gloss)
Mercury as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.14)
Mercury 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 57.12-13: when Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn, or with the Sun, Mars or Rahu, the start brings position and wealth and the middle and end bring disease, failures and anxiety.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS (and Santhanam's own doubt) give good results at the start even when Mercury is badly placed; the other texts give no such phase. Phaladeepika adds illness and trouble to siblings and children to an otherwise good list; Jataka Parijata and Raman give only good results.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a constructive phase for reputation, trade, learning and religious life. Where the chart shows the BPHS affliction, add that early gains may fade and advise caution later in the period. Do not predict death from the maraka examples.

library_entry.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is described as a troubled time in every source: loss of position, fear, poverty, foreign travel, quarrels with wife and children, wind and fever illness, and danger from snakes or poison. In Santhanam's reading BPHS holds this even when Ketu is well placed. Relief comes if Ketu is linked to the lagna lord, or in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Saturn. In the 8th or 12th it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: wind and fire ailments, harassment by enemies, constant quarrels with sons and wife, misfortune, danger from snakes (Phaladeepika 21.50)
wind and bile disease, quarrels with wicked people, bad dreams (Jataka Parijata 18.125)
rheumatism or sickness, danger of poison, trouble from sons, loss of money, quarrels with low people, bad dreams, family quarrels (Raman pp. 261-262)
loss of position, danger, poverty, distress, foreign journeys (BPHS 57.16-18)
rare_outcomes: imprisonment, loss of children or spouse (BPHS 57.17, Sanskrit gloss)
bathing in holy rivers and visiting shrines (BPHS 57.18-19)
[maraka: BPHS 57.20-21 predicts fear of premature death when Ketu is in the 8th or 12th]

by_area.personality: Religious thoughts, strength and courage when Ketu is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.19); fear and distress otherwise (BPHS 57.16).
by_area.career: Loss of position and suffering on behalf of one's master (BPHS 57.16-18); audience with rulers when Ketu is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.19).
by_area.finance: Poverty and loss of money (BPHS 57.17; Raman); wealth at the start if Ketu is linked to the lagna lord (BPHS 57.18).
by_area.health: Wind and fire or bile ailments (Phaladeepika 21.50; Jataka Parijata 18.125); cold fever, dysentery, wounds, poor food in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.20-21); physical distress in the 2nd/7th (BPHS 57.22).
by_area.relationships: Constant quarrels with wife and sons (Phaladeepika 21.50); separation from wife and children in the 8th/12th (BPHS 57.21).
by_area.family: Family quarrels and trouble from sons (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Bathing in holy rivers and visiting shrines when Ketu is linked to the lagna lord or well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.18-19).

strengtheners: Ketu related to the lagna lord (BPHS 57.18)
Ketu in a kendra, trikona, the 3rd or 11th from Saturn (BPHS 57.19)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.20-21)
Ketu in the 2nd or 7th from the lagna (BPHS 57.22)
Ketu 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 57.18: if Ketu is related to the lagna lord, the start of the sub-period brings wealth, enjoyment and pilgrimage.
library_entry.disagreements: Santhanam reads BPHS 57.16 as 'evil even if well placed'; the Sanskrit gloss reads verse 16 as favourable conditions and verse 17 as the contrary warning. All other texts give only adverse results.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe this as a short, unsettled phase that favours simplicity, spiritual practice and careful health habits. Mention relief or pilgrimage only when the chart has the listed links to the lagna lord or to Saturn. Do not predict premature death, imprisonment or loss of family.

library_entry.summary: Venus's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 3 years 2 months) is generally the best part of the period: marriage, children, wealth, good health, honours and goodwill of relatives. BPHS makes it good when Venus is in a kendra, trikona or the 11th with benefics, or in the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn. It is bad when Venus is debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn. Uttara Kalamrita adds a reversal: when both Venus and Saturn are very strong, their mutual periods can ruin even a king.
common_outcomes: contentment with friends, wife and children; wealth from farming and sea or river travel; wide renown (Phaladeepika 21.51)
goodwill of relatives, public approval, gain of wives, property and wealth, joys of agriculture (Jataka Parijata 18.126)
general happiness, favours and gifts, business profits, more family members, victory over enemies, wife's property (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: a kingdom or high office by the ruler's grace (BPHS 57.25-26)
composition of poetry and study of Vedanta (BPHS 57.31)
the native ruined even if born a king, when both Venus and Saturn are strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 28.5-29.5)

by_area.personality: Interest in shastras, poetry and Vedanta (BPHS 57.31); mental agony when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 57.29).
by_area.career: High office and honours by the ruler's favour (BPHS 57.25-26); loss of position and friction with officials when Venus is badly placed (BPHS 57.29, 57.34).
by_area.finance: Wealth, clothes, ornaments, conveyances (BPHS 57.25-27); business profits (Raman); wealth from agriculture and water travel (Phaladeepika 21.51).
by_area.health: Sound health when well placed (BPHS 57.25); eye trouble, fevers, dental problems, heart disease, pain in the arms, danger from drowning or falls when Venus is 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.32-34); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.35).
by_area.relationships: Marriage, birth of a son, happiness with wife and children (BPHS 57.24-25, 57.31; Phaladeepika 21.51; Jataka Parijata 18.126); distress to the wife when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 57.28-29).
by_area.family: Well-being in the family (BPHS 57.25); quarrels with close relations and brothers when afflicted (BPHS 57.29, 57.34); goodwill of relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.126).
by_area.spirituality: Charity, religious rites, Puranas and Vedanta when Venus is well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.30-31).

strengtheners: Venus in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 57.24-27)
Venus exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.24, Sanskrit gloss)
Venus in the 9th, 11th or a kendra from Saturn (BPHS 57.30-31)

weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus debilitated, combust, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 57.28-29)
Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.32-34)
Venus as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.35)
Venus and Saturn both very strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 28.5-29.5)
Venus 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman treat a strong Venus as good. Uttara Kalamrita says that when both Venus and Saturn are strong (exalted, own sign or vargottama) their mutual periods are disastrous, and that weakness and mutual 6/8/12 placement give good results. This is the reverse of BPHS 57.32-34. Santhanam requires benefic association with the kendra/trikona/11th placement; the Sanskrit gloss lists each as a separate good condition.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as usually the most pleasant phase of Saturn's period, good for marriage, family and comforts. If the chart has both Venus and Saturn very strong, mention the classical warning gently as a reason for caution with fortune and health, not as ruin. Avoid predicting harm to the spouse.

library_entry.summary: The Sun's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 11 months 12 days) is one of the hardest in the general texts: danger from enemies and rulers, illness of elders, eye and stomach disease, loss of wealth, and trouble to wife and children. Saturn and the Sun are enemies. BPHS makes it good (good relations with superiors, family well-being, conveyances) when the Sun is exalted, in its own sign, with the 9th lord, or in a kendra or trikona with benefics. It is bad when the Sun is in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn.
common_outcomes: danger from enemies at all times, illness of elders, stomach and eye disease, loss of money and grain (Phaladeepika 21.52)
loss of wife and children, trouble from the king or robbers, sinking of heart (Jataka Parijata 18.127)
trouble from rulers or robbers, heart weakness, blood and intestinal disorders, eye trouble, illness of wife and children (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: [maraka: Phaladeepika 21.52 and Raman p. 262 speak of danger of death]
fear of death to the father-in-law (Raman p. 262)
royal favour, wealth and happiness when both Saturn and the Sun are strong (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)

by_area.personality: Mental agony, fears and anxiety when the Sun is badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41); sinking of heart (Jataka Parijata 18.127).
by_area.career: Good relations with the employer when well placed (BPHS 57.37); defamation, loss of position and obstacles in industry when badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41); trouble from rulers (Jataka Parijata; Raman).
by_area.finance: Conveyances and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.37-38); loss of money and grain (Phaladeepika 21.52); loss of cherished things (BPHS 57.41).
by_area.health: Heart disease and fevers (BPHS 57.39-41); stomach and eye disease (Phaladeepika 21.52); blood and intestinal disorders (Raman); physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.42).
by_area.relationships: Loss of or trouble to wife and children (Jataka Parijata 18.127; Raman); happiness from children when well placed (BPHS 57.37).
by_area.family: Illness of elders (Phaladeepika 21.52); separation from close relatives and loss of kinsmen when badly placed (BPHS 57.39-41).

strengtheners: the Sun exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.37)
the Sun associated with the 9th lord (BPHS 57.37)
the Sun in a kendra or trikona with or aspected by benefics (BPHS 57.37-38)
Saturn and the Sun both in own or exalted signs or navamsas, or in or ruling kendras and trikonas (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Sun in the 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.39-41)
the Sun as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.42)
Saturn and the Sun both functional malefics (Uttara Kalamrita sec. 6, sl. 30.5-31.5)
the Sun 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS and Uttara Kalamrita allow good results when the Sun (and Saturn) are well placed; Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only adverse results. The Sanskrit gloss adds the lagna to the bad places in BPHS 57.39; Santhanam does not.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a short, testing phase: advise patience with bosses and officials, attention to health and eyes, and care for elders. Give the BPHS or Uttara Kalamrita favourable version when the chart supports it. Never predict death of the native, spouse, children or in-laws.

library_entry.summary: The Moon's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 7 months) is mixed: the general texts give illness, grief, death of an elder woman, family disputes and loss alongside some money and cattle. BPHS makes it good when the Moon is full, exalted, in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn, or aspected by benefics. It is bad when the Moon is waning, afflicted by malefics or debilitated. When the Moon is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn, it brings lethargy, loss of position and enemies.
common_outcomes: loss of the wife or danger to life, trouble with friends, disease, fear from water and wind (Phaladeepika 21.53)
death of a revered elder woman, sorrow, dislike of relatives, income, wind disease (Jataka Parijata 18.128)
more cattle, enmity of friends and relatives, colds, family disputes, loss of money and property, mortgage and later recovery of property (Raman p. 262)
rare_outcomes: conveyances, garments and ornaments through a great ruler (BPHS 57.43-44)
happiness in both maternal and paternal homes (BPHS 57.45)
[maraka: Phaladeepika 21.53 speaks of danger to life]

by_area.personality: Great distress and anger when the Moon is weak or afflicted (BPHS 57.46-47); sleepiness and lethargy when weak and 6/8/12 from Saturn (BPHS 57.51-52); sorrow (Jataka Parijata 18.128).
by_area.career: Favour of rulers when well placed (BPHS 57.44); losses in business and loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 57.47-48, 57.51-52).
by_area.finance: Conveyances, garments, ornaments and cattle when well placed (BPHS 57.43-45); losses in business (BPHS 57.48); mortgage of property and later recovery (Raman).
by_area.health: Irregular meals and medicines when afflicted (BPHS 57.48); disease and fear from water and wind (Phaladeepika 21.53); wind disease (Jataka Parijata 18.128); lethargy and physical distress as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.53).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife when well placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.49-50); loss or danger to the wife (Phaladeepika 21.53).
by_area.family: Happiness from parents, care of siblings when well placed (BPHS 57.43-45, 57.49-50); separation from parents and illness of children when afflicted (BPHS 57.47); death of an elder woman (Jataka Parijata 18.128).

strengtheners: the Moon full, exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.43)
the Moon in a kendra, trikona or the 11th from Saturn (BPHS 57.43, 57.49)
the Moon aspected by benefics, especially Jupiter (BPHS 57.43, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: the Moon waning, with or aspected by malefics, debilitated, or in a malefic sign or navamsa (BPHS 57.46-48)
the Moon weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.51-52)

library_entry.summary: Mars's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 1 year 1 month 9 days) is described in the general texts as a time of strife: loss of position, family disputes, serious illness, fever, danger from fire or weapons, more enemies and distress to brothers. BPHS makes it good from the start (wealth, government favour, command, farming, a new house) when Mars is exalted, in its own sign, or with the lagna lord or Saturn. It is bad when Mars is debilitated or combust, or in the 8th or 12th with malefics. When Mars is in the 2nd or rules the 7th or 8th, it warns of danger to life.
common_outcomes: loss of position, family disputes, serious illness, fever, danger from fire, weapons or poison, more enemies, hernia, eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.54)
loss of place, serious illness, many fears, distress of brothers and friends (Jataka Parijata 18.129)
disgrace, serious enmity, strife, wandering, unsettled life, loss by fraud or theft, change of residence, serious illness, distress to brothers, hot diseases (Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: command of an army and construction of a new house (BPHS 57.57)
[maraka: BPHS 57.61 predicts fear of premature death when Mars is in the 2nd or lord of the 7th or 8th]

by_area.personality: Great distress and dependence on others when Mars is in the 2nd or rules the 7th/8th (BPHS 57.61).
by_area.career: Government favour and command when Mars is strong (BPHS 57.55-57); loss of position (Phaladeepika 21.54; Jataka Parijata 18.129); disgrace (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth, conveyances, ornaments, farming and cattle, a new house when strong (BPHS 57.55-57); loss of wealth, thieves and needless spending when afflicted (BPHS 57.58-60); loss by fraud or theft (Raman).
by_area.health: Wounds, weapons, snakes, gout (BPHS 57.58-59); fever, fire, hernia, eye trouble (Phaladeepika 21.54); hot diseases (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels with co-partners when Mars is afflicted (BPHS 57.59).
by_area.family: Happiness to kin when Mars is strong (BPHS 57.57); distress to father and brothers and loss of kinsmen when afflicted (BPHS 57.59); family disputes (Phaladeepika 21.54).

strengtheners: Mars exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.55)
Mars with the lagna lord or with Saturn (BPHS 57.55-56)
Mars in a kendra, trikona or the 11th (BPHS 57.55, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars debilitated or combust (BPHS 57.58)
Mars in the 8th or 12th from the lagna with or aspected by malefics (BPHS 57.58)
Mars in the 2nd, or lord of the 7th or 8th (BPHS 57.61)
Mars 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 57.55-57: when Mars is well placed, the good results come from the very start of the sub-period.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives a strongly good version under listed conditions; the other texts give only adverse results. Santhanam requires malefic association together with the 8th/12th placement; the Sanskrit gloss treats malefic association as a separate bad condition. The two readings of verse 61 differ, as noted above.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a short, high-friction phase: advise caution with machinery, fire, travel and quarrels, and patience with siblings and partners. When the chart has the BPHS good conditions, emphasise property, land and energetic achievement. Do not predict premature death.

library_entry.summary: Rahu's sub-period in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 10 months 6 days) is described in all the general texts as difficult: quarrels, mental and physical pain, disease in the limbs, fevers, losses to rulers, robbers and enemies, foreign travel and loss of house or land. BPHS gives a better start (wealth, crops, pilgrimage) if Rahu is with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, exalted, or in a kendra or the 11th from the lagna or Saturn, and wealth and honour in certain signs. Association with the 2nd or 7th lord brings bodily distress.
common_outcomes: quarrels, mental agony, physical distress, friction with sons, fear of disease, needless spending, discord with relations, danger from government, foreign journeys, loss of house and fields (BPHS 57.63-64)
deceitful conduct, danger of diabetes or venereal disease, enlarged spleen, persistent fever, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.55)
disease in every limb, damage by robbers, enemies and greedy rulers, loss of wealth (Jataka Parijata 18.130; Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: elephants, opulence and royal favour when Rahu is in certain signs (BPHS 57.68)
loss of younger brothers in an accident (Rath, Crux, one chart example)

by_area.personality: Mental agony and quarrels (BPHS 57.63); deceitful conduct (Phaladeepika 21.55).
by_area.career: Danger from the government (BPHS 57.64); cordiality with rulers in the middle if well placed (BPHS 57.67, Santhanam); damage by greedy rulers (Jataka Parijata 18.130).
by_area.finance: Needless spending, loss of house and fields (BPHS 57.64); loss of wealth to robbers and rulers (Jataka Parijata 18.130; Raman); wealth, crops and cattle at the start when well placed (BPHS 57.65-67).
by_area.health: Physical distress and fear of disease (BPHS 57.63); diabetes or venereal disease, enlarged spleen, persistent fever, wounds (Phaladeepika 21.55); disease in every limb (Jataka Parijata 18.130).
by_area.relationships: Friction with sons (BPHS 57.63).
by_area.family: Discord with close relations (BPHS 57.64); family well-being when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 57.67).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and Brahmins and pilgrimage at the start when Rahu is well placed (BPHS 57.66).

strengtheners: Rahu with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka (BPHS 57.65)
Rahu exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.65)
Rahu in a kendra or the 11th from the lagna or from Saturn (BPHS 57.65)
Rahu in Aries, Virgo, Cancer, Taurus, Pisces or Sagittarius (BPHS 57.68; the Sanskrit gloss adds Leo)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu not exalted or otherwise well placed (BPHS 57.63-64)
Rahu associated with the lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 57.69)
Rahu 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 57.65-67: when Rahu is well placed, the start brings wealth, crops and pilgrimage; Santhanam makes the middle cordial with rulers and friends, while the Sanskrit gloss makes it a time of fear from the government and conflict with sons and friends.
library_entry.disagreements: For a well-placed Rahu, Santhanam reads the middle of the sub-period as cordiality with the ruler and happiness from friends; the Sanskrit gloss reads it as fear of government and conflict with sons and friends. The Sanskrit gloss adds Leo to the good signs of verse 68. Apart from BPHS, all sources give only adverse results.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a long, testing phase: advise care with health, documents, officials and property dealings, and steady routines for the mind. Give the BPHS better version only when the chart has the listed placements. Avoid naming specific diseases as predictions.

library_entry.summary: Jupiter's sub-period, the last in Saturn's dasha (about 2 years 6 months 12 days), is good in every general source: devotion to gods and teachers, royal favour, rank, family happiness and more wealth and grain. BPHS makes it good when Jupiter is in a kendra or trikona, exalted or in its own sign, or with the lagna lord, or 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn. It is bad when Jupiter is debilitated, with malefics or in a dusthana. As 2nd or 7th lord, BPHS warns of death in the family.
common_outcomes: devotion to gods and Brahmins, happiness with wife and children, great increase in wealth and grain (Phaladeepika 21.56)
devotion to gods and Brahmins, royal favour, great happiness, attainment of rank (Jataka Parijata 18.131)
worship of gods and holy people, family happiness, bodily comforts, goals met with help from superiors, a larger family circle, rank (Raman p. 263)
rare_outcomes: fame in the country, Vedic and Vedanta study, performance of sacrifices (BPHS 57.76-78)
imprisonment and fines when Jupiter is weak in a dusthana from Saturn (BPHS 57.79-80)
[maraka: BPHS 57.81 predicts death of the native or a family member when Jupiter is the 2nd or 7th lord]

by_area.personality: Religious-mindedness (BPHS 57.77); mental agony and quarrels when weak and badly placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.79).
by_area.career: Success all round, reverence and gains through government (BPHS 57.71-73, 57.76-77); rank (Jataka Parijata 18.131); help from superiors (Raman); friction with officials, failed projects, loss of position when afflicted (BPHS 57.74-75, 57.79).
by_area.finance: Conveyances, ornaments, clothes, opulence (BPHS 57.72, 57.76); more wealth and grain (Phaladeepika 21.56); loss of wealth and fines when afflicted (BPHS 57.75, 57.80).
by_area.health: Bodily comforts (Raman); disease such as leprosy (skin disease) when afflicted from the lagna (BPHS 57.75); bodily and mental illness as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.81).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 57.73, 57.76; Phaladeepika 21.56); distress to wife and son when Jupiter is weak and badly placed from Saturn (BPHS 57.80).
by_area.family: Family well-being and a larger family circle (BPHS 57.71; Raman); death of near relations when afflicted (BPHS 57.75).
by_area.spirituality: Devotion to deities and the guru, company of the learned (BPHS 57.73); Vedas, Vedanta, sacrifices and charity of grain (BPHS 57.77-78); worship of gods and Brahmins (Phaladeepika 21.56; Jataka Parijata 18.131).

strengtheners: Jupiter in a kendra or trikona, with the lagna lord, exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 57.71)
Jupiter in the 5th, 9th, 11th, 2nd or a kendra from Saturn (BPHS 57.76)
Jupiter in the 11th (BPHS 57.71, Sanskrit gloss)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter debilitated, with malefics, or in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna (BPHS 57.74-75)
Jupiter weak and in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Saturn (BPHS 57.79-80)
Jupiter as 2nd or 7th lord (BPHS 57.81)
Jupiter 6th from Saturn (Rath, Crux p. 330)
library_entry.disagreements: All sources agree this is a favourable sub-period by default. Only BPHS gives adverse versions, under affliction or as a maraka.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a supportive close to Saturn's period, good for family, faith, learning, recognition and resolving long-running matters. Mention the cautions only when the chart shows the BPHS afflictions. Do not predict the death of the native or family members.

library_entry.summary: Mercury's 17-year mahadasha is described in every source as a period of learning, speech, trade, friends and family happiness, with honour from rulers or superiors when Mercury is strong. When Mercury is joined with malefics, debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th, the same period brings quarrels with relatives, losses, nervous or wind ailments and trouble from authorities. BPHS adds that the start is good, the middle brings recognition and the last part is troubled.
common_outcomes: gain of wealth, reputation and knowledge, royal favour, auspicious functions, happiness from wife and children, profit in business, when Mercury is well placed (BPHS 47.62-65)
meeting friends, personal comforts, fame through the praise of learned people, favour from elders, skill in speech, doing good to others, an elevated position (Phaladeepika 19.10)
money through seniors, relatives and friends, fame and happiness, going on an embassy or errand, income from dealing in gold, some wind ailment (Jataka Parijata 18.133)
garments, large wealth, grain, position, a mansion, fulfilment of wishes when Mercury is auspicious (Uttara Kalamrita, 'Dasas and their effects' sl. 8-9)
rare_outcomes: gain of new lands, cows and horses; money through Brahmins; worship of great men and gods; illness from wind, heat and phlegm (Phaladeepika 19.24, a second verse on Mercury's dasa)
journey to a foreign country and dependence on others when Mercury is with malefics (BPHS 47.66)
loss of wealth through lascivious habits, rheumatism and jaundice when Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.67-68)
book writing and fame as a communicator when Mercury is linked to the houses of writing and fame (P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, example 52)

by_area.personality: Clear speech, cleverness and a helpful nature (Phaladeepika 19.10); growth of intelligence (BPHS 47.63). When Mercury is afflicted: short temper and weakened intellect (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 8-9).
by_area.career: Favour from government and superiors, good standing, profit in trade (BPHS 47.62-65); an elevated position (Phaladeepika 19.10); errands or embassies (Jataka Parijata 18.133). Punishment or displeasure from government when Mercury is with malefics or in a dusthana (BPHS 47.66-68); trouble from the trading class (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 8-9).
by_area.finance: Wealth through business, seniors, relatives and friends (BPHS 47.64; Jataka Parijata 18.133); dealing in gold (Jataka Parijata 18.133). Loss of wealth, land and cattle when Mercury is in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.67-68).
by_area.health: Good health when Mercury is strong (BPHS 47.64). Wind ailments (Jataka Parijata 18.133); wind, heat and phlegm disorders (Phaladeepika 19.24); urinary trouble when Mercury is with malefics; rheumatism and jaundice when in a dusthana (BPHS 47.66-68).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife and children (BPHS 47.64; Phaladeepika 19.10). Marriage is mentioned for Mercury in Aries, Gemini, Leo and Virgo (Raman, HPA pp. 264-265); loss of wife and children for Mercury in Scorpio (Raman).
by_area.family: Birth of children in the early part (BPHS 47.69); enmity with relatives when Mercury is with malefics (BPHS 47.66); loss of relations when Mercury is malefic (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 8-9).
by_area.spirituality: Worship of gods and great men, benefit from spiritual teachers (Phaladeepika 19.24); religious and charitable work for Mercury in Aries, Virgo and Sagittarius; recitation of scriptures for Gemini and Capricorn (Raman, HPA pp. 264-265).

strengtheners: Mercury exalted, in its own sign or a friendly sign (BPHS 47.62)
Mercury in the 5th, 9th or 11th (Santhanam's reading) or in a kendra, the 11th or a trikona (Sanskrit gloss) (BPHS 47.62)
aspect of a benefic, placement in the 9th, or Mercury ruling the 10th, which gives the good results in full (BPHS 47.65)
Mercury retrograde, or vargottama (Phaladeepika 20.14, 20.22)
Mercury in an upachaya house from the lagna (Jataka Parijata 18.14, 18.16)
weakeners_or_cancellations: association with a malefic (BPHS 47.66)
placement in the 6th, 8th or 12th (BPHS 47.67-68)
debilitation, an enemy's sign, or the 6th or 12th: a benefic then gives only untoward results (Phaladeepika 20.27)
combustion ('eclipsed' by the Sun): adverse results (Phaladeepika 20.14)
library_entry.phases: BPHS 47.69-70: the start brings wealth, progress in education, birth of children and happiness; the middle brings recognition from government; the last part is distressing. Phaladeepika 20.57: a combust or debilitated Mercury in an auspicious sign or navamsa gives its good effects in the later part. Frawley (p. 203): the opening sub-period of a benefic's dasa plants seeds rather than fruit, and is a good time to set goals.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS 47.62: Santhanam lists the 11th, 5th or 9th as an alternative to good dignity, while the Sanskrit gloss requires good dignity and also a kendra, the 11th or a trikona. BPHS gives the end of the dasa as distressing; Phaladeepika and Jataka Parijata do not divide the period. Phaladeepika 19.10 is wholly favourable, while 19.24 adds wind, heat and phlegm diseases. Raman makes Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces bad signs for this dasa even though Pisces is only Mercury's debilitation sign and Cancer and Scorpio are not named by the classical dasa verses. Phaladeepika 20.14 treats retrogression as favourable; other sources here are silent.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Frame this as a long period for study, communication, trade and networks, whose tone depends on Mercury's dignity, house and associations. Mention the troubled version only when the chart shows the listed conditions, and keep health notes general (nerves, digestion), with no diagnosis. Present the BPHS start-middle-end pattern as a tendency, not a certainty.

library_entry.summary: Mercury's own sub-period at the start of its mahadasha (about 2 years 4 months 27 days) is favourable in every classical source: learning, fame, gains through relatives, success in undertakings, a good house and clothes. BPHS turns it bad when Mercury is debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics, and warns of distress to the wife and deaths in the family when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: pearls and gems, learning, success in education, fame, meeting new dignitaries, wealth, happiness from wife, children and parents (BPHS 58.1-3)
devotion to virtue, company of the learned, a clear mind, money through Brahmins, fame from learning, lasting happiness (Phaladeepika 21.57)
beautiful houses and clothes, money through Brahmins and relatives, success in every undertaking (Jataka Parijata 18.134)
a fine house and clothes, money through relatives, success, gain of a brother or sister, growth of the family, business gains, charity, study of mathematics and arts (Raman, p. 266)
rare_outcomes: distress to the wife, deaths in the family, rheumatism and stomach pain when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5)
overwork and its effects, headaches (Rele, p. 96)

by_area.personality: A clear, unbiased mind and devotion to virtue (Phaladeepika 21.57); good mind (Raman).
by_area.career: Success in studies and fame; meeting new superiors (BPHS 58.1-3); success in every undertaking (Jataka Parijata 18.134). Anxiety in official duties when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.finance: Wealth, gems, business gains (BPHS 58.1-3; Raman); loss of wealth and cattle when Mercury is debilitated or in a dusthana (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.health: Stomach pain and illness when Mercury is afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3); rheumatism when it rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5); headaches (Rele).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from wife (BPHS 58.1-3); distress to the wife when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5).
by_area.family: Happiness from children and parents (BPHS 58.1-3); growth of the family and a new sibling (Raman); antagonism with kin when afflicted (BPHS 58.1-3).
by_area.spirituality: Pious deeds and virtuous conduct (BPHS 58.1-3; Phaladeepika 21.57); charity (Raman).

strengtheners: Mercury exalted or in its own sign (BPHS 58.1-3)
Mercury in the 11th, a kendra or a trikona (Rele, p. 96)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury debilitated, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with malefics (BPHS 58.1-3)
Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.4-5)
library_entry.disagreements: Santhanam's maraka verse reads 'Mercury lord of the 2nd or 7th'; the Sanskrit gloss reads the 2nd lord who also owns the 7th. Rele adds aspect by a malefic to the bad conditions. Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only favourable results, without conditions.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a good opening for study, skills, writing and family matters, unless the chart shows the listed afflictions. Do not predict deaths in the family; at most suggest attention to the spouse's and elders' wellbeing when Mercury rules the 2nd or 7th.

library_entry.summary: Ketu's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 11 months 27 days) is mostly described as troubled: sorrow, quarrels, illness, trouble from relatives, failure in business and loss of land or vehicles. BPHS makes it good when Ketu is with benefics in a kendra or trikona, joined with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka, or in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury, and bad when Ketu is with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury.
common_outcomes: trouble from relatives, mental agony, loss of comfort, fear of an enemy, failure in business (Jataka Parijata 18.135)
distress, sorrow, quarrels, confusion, trembling of the body, hostile company, loss of land and vehicles (Phaladeepika 21.58)
sorrow, disease, loss of work and dharma, bilious illness, aimless wandering, loss of property, misfortune to relatives, trouble through doctors (Raman, p. 267)
rare_outcomes: a fall from a vehicle, distress to a son, danger from the ruler, danger from scorpions and stinging creatures (BPHS 58.9-11)
a banquet with the king, honours, income from industry when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8)

by_area.personality: Confusion and mental agony (Phaladeepika 21.58; Jataka Parijata 18.135); a tendency to wrong deeds when afflicted (BPHS 58.9-11).
by_area.career: Failure in business (Jataka Parijata 18.135; Raman); loss of work (Raman). When well placed: honours, audience with the ruler, success in studies, income from industry (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.finance: Loss of property, land and vehicles (Phaladeepika 21.58; Raman). Late or modest gain of wealth and more cattle when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.health: Disease, bilious illness, trembling of the body (Phaladeepika 21.58; Raman); physical distress when Ketu is 'lord of the 2nd or 7th' (BPHS 58.12).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels and hostile or low company (Phaladeepika 21.58; BPHS 58.9-11).
by_area.family: Trouble from relatives (Jataka Parijata 18.135); distress to a son (BPHS 58.9-11); affection with kin when well placed (BPHS 58.6-8).
by_area.spirituality: Loss of dharma (Raman, p. 267).

strengtheners: Ketu with benefics in a kendra or trikona from the lagna (BPHS 58.6-8)
Ketu with the lagna lord or a yogakaraka (BPHS 58.6-8)
Ketu in a kendra or the 11th from Mercury (BPHS 58.6-8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.9-11)
library_entry.phases: The Sanskrit gloss of BPHS 58.9 says the good results come at the start and middle of the sub-period. Santhanam (58.6-8) says wealth comes late.
library_entry.disagreements: BPHS gives good results under several conditions, while Phaladeepika, Jataka Parijata and Raman give only troubled results with no conditions. Santhanam's bad condition is Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury; the Sanskrit gloss of verse 9 reads it as the dasa lord in the 8th or 12th or with malefics. Rele counts the 6th, 8th and 12th, and counts from the lagna as well as from the dasa lord.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Describe a short, unsettled stretch: advise patience in business, care in travel and calm handling of relatives. Give the favourable version only when the chart shows the listed placements. Avoid predicting accidents or harm to children.

library_entry.summary: Venus's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 2 years 10 months) is one of the best parts of the period in every source: religious and charitable acts, wealth, clothes and ornaments, help from friends and rulers, married happiness. BPHS makes it bad when Venus is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury, and warns of danger when Venus rules the 2nd or 7th.
common_outcomes: worship of gods, Brahmins and elders, generous gifts, devotion to duty, clothes and ornaments, meeting friends (Phaladeepika 21.59)
presents to seniors, gods and Brahmins, conduct by religion and morality, wealth, clothing and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.136)
wealth, clothes and jewels, good children, married happiness, prospering relatives, growing trade, knowledge, return from a long journey, betrothal if unmarried, vehicles and a house (Raman, p. 267)
rare_outcomes: a high position in government, building of a reservoir (BPHS 58.13-15)
heart disease, defamation, fever, dysentery when Venus is weak in a dusthana from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17)
renunciation, in one example chart (Rath, Crux pp. 389-390)

by_area.personality: Inclination to religious rites and truthfulness (BPHS 58.13-15; Rele).
by_area.career: Ambitions fulfilled through the ruler and friends; a high position; extraordinary gains in business (BPHS 58.13-15); trade increases (Raman). Loss of position and credit when Venus is in a dusthana (Rele).
by_area.finance: Agricultural land, wealth and property (BPHS 58.13-15); wealth, ornaments, vehicles and a house (Raman).
by_area.health: Good health (Raman). Heart disease, fever, dysentery when Venus is weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury (BPHS 58.16-17).
by_area.relationships: Married happiness, betrothal (Raman); meeting friends (Phaladeepika 21.59).
by_area.family: Birth of good children; relatives prosper (Raman). Separation from kin when Venus is afflicted (BPHS 58.16-17).
by_area.spirituality: Religious rites, charity, building of water works (BPHS 58.13-15); worship of gods, Brahmins and elders (Phaladeepika 21.59; Jataka Parijata 18.136).

library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a generous, sociable and prosperous stretch, good for family events, study and business. Mention the health cautions only if the chart shows the listed conditions. Do not mention premature death; at most advise care with health when Venus is a maraka.

library_entry.summary: The Sun's sub-period in Mercury's dasa (about 10 months 6 days) brings royal or official favour, gold and possessions, good food and honour in the classical texts, though Raman lists mostly troubles (head and stomach pains, enemies, trouble through superiors) along with some gain. BPHS makes it good when the Sun is strong or in good houses, and bad when it is in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mercury, weak, or with Saturn, Mars or Rahu.
common_outcomes: gold, coral, horses and elephants for the household, plenty of food and drink, honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.60)
clothes, ornaments and wealth, royal favour, great ease, hearing moral teachings (Jataka Parijata 18.137)
head and stomach pains, enmity, loss of respect, danger of fire, anxieties, illness of the wife, enemies, obstacles, trouble through superiors, some gain of wealth (Raman, pp. 267-268)
rare_outcomes: acquisition of land when the Sun is aspected by Mars (BPHS 58.21)
danger from thieves, fire and weapons; separation from friends (BPHS 58.23-24)

by_area.personality: Mental agony when the Sun is afflicted (BPHS 58.23-24); anxieties (Raman).
by_area.career: Fortune through the favour of high officials (BPHS 58.20-22); honour from the ruler (Phaladeepika 21.60). Trouble through superiors and loss of respect (Raman).
by_area.finance: Gold and valuables (Phaladeepika 21.60); wealth, clothes and ornaments (Jataka Parijata 18.137); land if the Sun is aspected by Mars (BPHS 58.21).
by_area.health: Bilious trouble, headaches (BPHS 58.23-24); head and stomach pains (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness from friends (BPHS 58.20); separation from friends when afflicted (BPHS 58.23-24); illness of the wife (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Hearing moral teachings (Jataka Parijata 18.137).

strengtheners: Sun exalted or in its own sign, in a kendra, trikona, the 2nd or 11th, or in an exalted or own navamsa (BPHS 58.20)
aspect of Mars (land) or the lagna lord (food and clothes) (BPHS 58.21-22)
Sun and Mercury both strong (Uttara Kalamrita sl. 32-33)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Sun in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna or from Mercury, weak, or with Saturn, Mars and Rahu (BPHS 58.23-24)
Sun lord of the 2nd or 7th (BPHS 58.25)
library_entry.disagreements: The classical texts are largely favourable, while Raman's list is mostly troubles. BPHS gives the maraka danger for the Sun as lord of the 2nd or 7th; Rele gives it for the Sun placed in the 2nd or 7th. For the remedy, Santhanam has worship of the Sun; the Sanskrit gloss has a shanti ritual.
library_entry.phrasing_guidance: Present this as a short period of dealings with authority: support from officials if the Sun is strong, friction and fatigue if afflicted. Keep health notes general (headaches, digestion). Do not mention premature death.

placement_entries.summary: The Sun in the 5th gives a sharp mind, but the classics read it as poor for children, wealth and happiness. Modern writers soften this to delay and a need for discipline.
common_outcomes: Intelligent (Phaladeepika 8.3, Raman HPA)
Few or no children, or difficulty with children (Phaladeepika 8.3, Brihat Jataka 20.2, Raman)
Little wealth or happiness (Phaladeepika 8.3, Brihat Jataka 20.2, Raman)
rare_outcomes: Fond of roaming in forests or mountains (Phaladeepika 8.3; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Courtier with an unsteady mind who stays abroad (Jataka Parijata 8.71; printed '6th' in the scan, but it sits in the 5th-house sequence)
Danger to the father early; lover of fine arts; tactful decisions (Raman HPA)
Difficult childbirth (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)

by_area.personality: Intelligent but disturbed in mind; tactful in decisions (Raman HPA).
by_area.career: Courtier or attendant on a ruler (Jataka Parijata 8.71); teaching authority (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Poor or without wealth (Phaladeepika 8.3, Brihat Jataka 20.2, Raman HPA).
by_area.health: Raman (How to Judge a Horoscope) lists heart disease.
by_area.family: Few children (Raman HPA), childless (Brihat Jataka 20.2); an afflicted Sun shows delay rather than a fixed outcome (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: Mantra practice suits this placement (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: The 5th is a trikona, giving a dignified mind and disciplined parenting (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Affliction brings delay with children (PanchangBodh); VedicFeed links afflicted Sun here to childbirth difficulty
placement_entries.disagreements: The classics and Raman are negative on children and wealth; PanchangBodh treats this as delay, not denial, and VedicFeed is mostly positive (creativity, popularity). Jataka Parijata alone gives court service and life abroad.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with intelligence and creative or teaching ability. If children come up, speak of patience and timing, never of childlessness, and do not repeat longevity or heart notes.

placement_entries.summary: Leo is the Sun's own sign; 0-20° is its moolatrikona and 20-30° own sign. It gives authority, courage, self-respect and a love of open, wild places, with a quick temper.
common_outcomes: Natural authority and leadership, strong self-respect
Courage and decisive action; defeats rivals
Love of nature, forests, hills and open spaces
Quick to anger; proud
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka says the native is vigorous but lacks knowledge
Saravali 22.34-35 says the native becomes a wealthy, famous ruler
Saravali 22.34-35 mentions fondness for meat

by_area.personality: Quick to anger, enthusiastic, valorous, talkative and restless (Saravali 22.34-35); vigorous (Brihat Jataka 18.2); stubborn, strong, independent and generous (Raman HPA ch. XXII).
by_area.career: Notable deeds and kingly status (Saravali 22.34-35); Raman: organising capacity and talent for propaganda; Braha ('Planets in the Houses') gives fame and high position when the own-sign Sun is in the 10th.
by_area.finance: Saravali 22.34-35: plentiful wealth and fame; Raman: poor. The texts disagree.

strengtheners: Within 0-20° (moolatrikona) per BPHS 3.51
Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 22.36-41: builds temples, gardens and tanks; highly intelligent) or Mars's aspect (courage, leadership)
Moon's aspect (Saravali 22.36-41: scholarship, royal favour)
Kendra or trikona placement; Braha (p. 50) says planets in kendras are powerful and those in trikonas flourish
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus's aspect (Saravali 22.36-41: bad repute)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 22.36-41: obstruction)
Mercury's aspect gives learning but Saravali also notes gambling or a mean streak
Placement in a dusthana (6th, 8th, 12th); Braha (pp. 51-52) says a planet there is spoiled, the 6th being the mildest
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka says vigour without knowledge; Saravali stresses wealth, fame and rulership; Raman calls the native poor. All agree on courage and love of wild places. BPHS 3.51-54 puts the moolatrikona at 0-20 degrees Leo; Frawley (p. 127) gives 4-20 degrees.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as strong leadership and self-belief; suggest channelling pride and temper constructively. Do not promise status.

placement_entries.summary: The Moon in the 11th gives gains, fame, a noble and generous nature, many friends and a long, prosperous life.
common_outcomes: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.7, Brihat Jataka 20.5, Jataka Parijata 8.94, Raman)
Famous (Brihat Jataka 20.5; Raman)
Noble-minded and generous (Phaladeepika 8.7; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Children, servants or helpers, and many friends (Phaladeepika 8.7, Raman)
rare_outcomes: Pensive or introspective disposition (Jataka Parijata 8.94; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Helped by women; vast lands (Raman)

by_area.personality: Noble, polite, cultured, quiet-going (Raman).
by_area.career: Great position and business profits (Raman).
by_area.finance: Wealth through people, clients and communities; income grows with the network (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.7).
by_area.relationships: Many friends; helped by women (Raman).
by_area.family: Wife and children (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); many children (Raman HPA).

strengtheners: Sastri's note to Brihat Jataka: the Moon is very good in the 11th
Cancer or Taurus adds loyalty; a waning Moon loses less here (PanchangBodh)
placement_entries.disagreements: No real disagreement; PanchangBodh and VedicFeed add that satisfaction from gains may be brief.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak of supportive networks, generosity and growing gains; mention that contentment matters as much as acquisition.

placement_entries.summary: The Moon in Aquarius is in Saturn's other sign (neutral). Texts describe a tireless traveller with fluctuating fortunes, fond of perfumes, flowers and friends, but warn of a restless, rule-bending streak.
common_outcomes: Rising and falling fortunes
Enjoys travel and is tireless on journeys
Fond of friends, perfumes and flowers
Unconventional or rule-bending tendencies
rare_outcomes: Saravali 23.72: artisan; diseased eyes; very poor
Brihat Jataka 17.11: signs of frailty in later years
Phaladeepika 9.11: skilled at harming rivals; greedy

by_area.personality: Secretive wrongdoing (Phaladeepika 9.11) and aversion to the virtuous (Saravali 23.72) in the classical verses; Raman HPA ch. XXII gives beautiful-minded, artistic, inoffensive and grateful, with a tendency to hypocrisy.
by_area.career: Artisan (Saravali 23.72); endures long journeys (Phaladeepika 9.11); Raman: artistic taste, esoteric interests.
by_area.finance: Gains and losses alternate (Brihat Jataka 17.11; Phaladeepika 9.11); Saravali 23.72: very poor; Raman: sudden rises and falls.
by_area.relationships: Brihat Jataka 17.11 cautions about involvement in others' partners or wealth; handle gently.
by_area.spirituality: Saravali 23.72: averse to conventional virtue; Raman: esoteric and mystical.

strengtheners: Strong sign lord (Saturn): Saravali 23.88 says the Moon-sign results come to pass fully only when the Moon, its sign and that sign's lord are strong
Jupiter's aspect (Saravali 23.73-78: land and estates)
Saturn's aspect (Saravali 23.73-78: property and wealth)
Mercury's aspect (Saravali 23.73-78: musical skill)
Sun's aspect (Saravali 23.73-78: dignified bearing)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Venus's aspect (Saravali 23.73-78: baseness, childlessness)
Mars's aspect (Saravali 23.73-78: indolence)
Waning or dim Moon, which Braha (pp. 19-20) treats as malefic and weaker
placement_entries.disagreements: Saravali is the harshest (poverty, vices); Brihat Jataka and Phaladeepika give fluctuating rather than ruined fortunes.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as an independent, sociable, travel-loving mind with variable fortune. Avoid moral or addiction claims; suggest steady routines.

placement_entries.summary: Mars in the 9th gives authority, renown and an active, combative relationship with belief, but most texts flag friction with the father and questionable conduct.
common_outcomes: Strained relations with the father or parents (Phaladeepika 8.10, Jataka Parijata 8.86; Raman)
Renowned or famous in other respects (Jataka Parijata 8.86; Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Wields authority and is affluent (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); friend of the ruler (Phaladeepika 8.10)
Stubborn, impetuous and self-seeking (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Commits sinful acts (Brihat Jataka 20.6)
Prone to violence; disliked by many (Phaladeepika 8.10)

by_area.personality: Logical, acute, stubborn and impetuous (Raman HPA); risk of dogmatism (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Trader (Raman HPA); fortune through initiative, land, engineering, law or leadership (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Affluent (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.family: Not a dutiful son (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope); sickly father (Raman HPA); loss of the father (Phaladeepika 8.10); children and happiness (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope).
by_area.spirituality: Belief made active; defends principles and causes (PanchangBodh).

Venus with Mars: proficiency in law, foreign residence (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope)
Mars is yogakaraka for Cancer and Leo lagna (PanchangBodh)

placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Speak of strong convictions, initiative and fortune through action, and of a spirited bond with the father or mentors. Do not predict a parent's loss or moral failings.

Harsh speech (Phaladeepika 8.12; Saravali 30.43; Raman)
Indolent or lazy (Phaladeepika 8.12; Saravali 30.43; Raman)
Quarrelsome or showy, yet respected (Jataka Parijata 8.76; Bhrigu Sutras 41-47; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Success in litigation and disputes (Saravali 30.43)
Favour from the government, notably around the 30th year; writes letters or books (Bhrigu Sutras 41-47)
Obstacles or interruptions in education (Bhrigu Sutras 41-47; Raman)

by_area.personality: Quick to anger and quarrel (Phaladeepika 8.12); not given to anger but much insulted (Saravali 30.43); instructive, amusing, quarrelsome but friendly (Jataka Parijata 8.76).
by_area.career: Accountants, auditors, lawyers, analysts, physicians, administrators (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Debts organised rather than ignored (PanchangBodh); earns by own efforts (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).
by_area.health: Contracts diseases (Saravali 30.43); in Aries or Scorpio skin disease, with Saturn and Rahu/Ketu rheumatic pains (Bhrigu Sutras 41-47); afflicted, nervous strain (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Quarrels with people of his own community (Bhrigu Sutras 41-47); no kindness to relatives (Jataka Parijata 8.76).
by_area.spirituality: Joined by Jupiter, spiritual gains (Raman).

strengtheners: Exalted or own sign: Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full (exaltation) through 3/4 (moolatrikona) and 1/2 (own sign) down to little in enemy signs
In a kendra in Gemini or Virgo it forms Bhadra Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Fortified Mercury sharpens the intellect; with Jupiter, spiritual gains (Raman)
Gemini or Virgo gives precision (PanchangBodh)
Satyacharya, as read by Bhattotpala (Brihat Jataka 20.10 notes): a benefic in the 6th destroys enemies
weakeners_or_cancellations: Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 14 deg (12 deg retrograde)
Debilitation in Pisces (Brihat Jataka 20.11 scale; Bhrigu Sutras)
Mercury turns malefic when joined or aspected by malefics (Bhrigu Sutras commentary on house 1)
Afflicted by Mars and Rahu or Saturn and Rahu: serious mental strain, trouble with servants (Raman)
In Aries or Scorpio, skin trouble (Bhrigu Sutras 41-47)
placement_entries.disagreements: Temper: Phaladeepika 8.12 says quick to anger, Saravali 30.43 says not given to anger. Enemies: Brihat Jataka has none, Phaladeepika and Raman defeat them, Bhrigu Sutras and Chamatkar Chintamani have quarrels. The Bhrigu Sutras commentator finds the authorities agree only that enemies are absent or overcome.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a sharp, argumentative but effective problem-solver suited to analytical service work. Mention health only as a reason for routine; give no diagnoses.

placement_entries.summary: Mercury in Virgo (Kanya) is in its exaltation, moolatrikona and own sign at once: the strongest possible sign for Mercury, giving a precise, discerning, articulate and skilful mind with gifts for writing, analysis and the arts.
common_outcomes: Sharp, analytical and well-organised mind
Eloquent and skilled in writing, poetry, crafts or technical arts
Generous, wise and patient; reasons well
Respected by learned or good people
rare_outcomes: Saravali notes the native may be the eldest child and is attractive to others but of modest vigour
Forms Bhadra Mahapurusha Yoga in a kendra from the lagna
Saravali also calls the native argumentative despite being modest

by_area.personality: Saravali 26.11-12: virtuous, eloquent, sweet, modest and argumentative. Brihat Jataka 18.10 (Sastri): liberal, forgiving, inventive and fearless.
by_area.career: Saravali 26.11-12: skilled in writing, poetry and fine or mechanical arts; disposed to serve others.
by_area.finance: Saravali calls the native charitable; Brihat Jataka 18.10 (Sastri): lives in comfort.
by_area.relationships: Saravali 26.11-12: liked by women.
by_area.family: Saravali: often the eldest child.
by_area.spirituality: Saravali: honoured by the virtuous.

strengtheners: Exaltation: deepest at 15 degrees Virgo (BPHS 3.49-50); moolatrikona after the exaltation portion, own sign for the rest (BPHS 3.53). Braha: Mercury functions best in the first half of Virgo
Phaladeepika 3.18: an exalted planet is 'blazing', in moolatrikona 'happy'
Bhadra Yoga if in a kendra from the lagna (Phaladeepika 6.1-2; Raman no. 23)

Saravali 26.37-42 (Gemini/Virgo group): Sun's aspect gives truthfulness and royal favour; Jupiter's aspect a minister's post and wealth; Saturn's aspect success and wealth; Moon's aspect study of the Sastras and success in all undertakings
Foss: Virgo is where Mercury is happiest (own, moolatrikona and exaltation together)
weakeners_or_cancellations: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (Sun and 'Combustion' sections): a planet within about 8 degrees of the Sun is combust and its significations and the houses it rules are spoiled; Raman (Budha-Aditya Yoga) suggests Mercury may partly escape this
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (rules of interpretation): planets in kendras are powerful, in trikonas enhanced, in the 6th, 8th or 12th spoiled
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a planet exalted in the birth chart but debilitated in the navamsa gives very mixed results
Saravali 26.37-42: Mars' aspect gives genius but an injured body; Venus' aspect gives learning but low company
placement_entries.disagreements: Sources agree this is Mercury's best sign. BPHS 3.53 gives only the length of the moolatrikona portion (5 degrees after the exaltation portion), so the exact boundary at 15 or 16 degrees depends on interpretation; Braha simply says the first half of Virgo is best. Saravali's 'less virile' and 'argumentative' remarks are not found in Brihat Jataka.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a strong, precise and capable mind. Avoid overpromising: an exalted Mercury still depends on its house, combustion and the rest of the chart. Do not repeat Saravali's remark on virility.

placement_entries.summary: Jupiter in the 3rd is one of its weaker classical placements: stinginess is the common thread, with humiliation or sinfulness in Phaladeepika and Saravali; Raman and PanchangBodh are milder, reading a thoughtful counsellor who is less suited to bold action.
common_outcomes: Stingy or miserly (Phaladeepika 8.14; Brihat Jataka 20.7; Bhrigu Sutras 13-18; Raman)
Many or notable siblings (Phaladeepika 8.14; Bhrigu Sutras 13-18; Raman)
Humiliated or disrespected (Phaladeepika 8.14; Saravali 30.52)
Optimistic, philosophical mind (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Dominated by the wife (Saravali 30.52; Jataka Parijata 8.66)
Ever successful despite the faults (Saravali 30.52)
Travel around the 38th year (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18); text detail only
Fortunate yet unable to earn as much as he hopes (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Malicious, sinful (Phaladeepika 8.14); clever and determined (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18); optimistic but conventional, misses opportunities (Raman); a counsellor more than a fighter, may hesitate (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Writers, editors, teachers, publishers (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Indigent (Jataka Parijata 8.66); poor if the 3rd lord is afflicted (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18).
by_area.health: Digestive weakness (Saravali 30.52); body heated, ill health (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Few friends (Raman); friend to nobody (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).
by_area.family: A brother of high standing (Phaladeepika 8.14); strong 3rd lord gives long-lived brothers (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18); sibling relations ethical but sometimes distant (PanchangBodh).
by_area.spirituality: Faith grows through personal experience (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Cancer) or own sign (Sagittarius, Pisces): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly gives the full good results only in own or exaltation sign
In a kendra in Sagittarius, Pisces or Cancer it forms Hamsa Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Strong 3rd lord: long-lived brothers (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18)
Upachaya house: improves with effort and age (PanchangBodh)
Its aspects on the 7th, 9th and 11th support marriage, fortune and gains (Bhrigu Sutras commentary; PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Capricorn, an enemy's sign or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 5-6, 10-12)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust
Kendra ownership (kendradhipati dosha) for Gemini and Virgo lagnas, where Jupiter is also a maraka (PanchangBodh)
3rd lord with a malefic: loss of brothers, impatience, poverty (Bhrigu Sutras 13-18)
Afflicted: ingratitude (Raman)
placement_entries.disagreements: Phaladeepika 8.14, Saravali 30.52 and Jataka Parijata 8.66 are negative (sinful, humiliated, henpecked); Brihat Jataka says only stingy; Raman calls it 'also a good position' while listing faults; PanchangBodh and the Bhrigu Sutras commentator treat the negatives as applying only under affliction. Saravali alone adds 'ever successful'.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as a reflective, principled person who may be cautious with money and slow to push. Avoid moral labels like 'sinful' or 'vile'.

placement_entries.summary: Jupiter in Gemini (Mithuna), Mercury's air sign and an enemy's sign for Jupiter, gives a scholarly, eloquent and courteous mind: knowledge expressed through words, writing and teaching, with comfortable means and many friends.
common_outcomes: Learned, articulate and courteous
Skilled and virtuous; respects elders and relatives
Good writer or poet
Comfortable means, good clothes, many friends
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.12 (Jupiter in a Mercury sign): ministerial position
Saravali 27.37-42: with Mercury's aspect, a skilled astrologer

by_area.personality: Saravali 27.5-6: eloquent, courteous and virtuous; honours elders and relatives.
by_area.career: Brihat Jataka 18.12: posted as a minister. Saravali 27.5-6: a good poet, skilful.
by_area.finance: Saravali calls the native affluent.
by_area.family: Respects elders and relatives (Saravali); Brihat Jataka mentions many sons.
by_area.spirituality: Saravali 27.5-6: devoted to his duties.

strengtheners: Saravali 27.37-42 (Gemini/Virgo group): Sun's aspect makes an important householder with wife, sons and money; Moon's aspect gives affluence, fortune and happiness; Mercury's aspect gives a skilled astrologer and fine speaker; Venus' aspect leads to temple building; Saturn's aspect gives leadership of a group, state or village
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Enemy's sign (Phaladeepika 3.19)
Saravali 27.37-42: Mars' aspect gives easy success and wealth but plain looks; Venus' aspect, alongside temple building, adds loose relationships
placement_entries.disagreements: Enemy-sign dignity is not reflected in the classical sign verses, which are favourable; Sastri's note says Jupiter is good in every sign except Capricorn.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe an articulate, learned communicator with a gift for teaching and advice. Keep the minister line as advisory influence, conditional on the wider chart.

placement_entries.summary: Venus in the 4th is a strong placement with directional strength: a beautiful home, vehicles, ornaments, fragrance, friends and happiness; Jataka Parijata adds being overruled by the spouse.
common_outcomes: Good vehicles and home (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.65; Raman)
Ornaments, clothing and perfumes (Phaladeepika 8.17)
Relatives, friends and happiness (Saravali 30.65; Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7; Raman)
Handsome and fortunate (Saravali 30.65; Bhrigu Sutras 23-28)
rare_outcomes: Overruled by the spouse while boasting of comforts and learning (Jataka Parijata 8.69)
Receives many gifts from followers; looks after the mother from early life (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Horse-drawn conveyances around the 30th year (Bhrigu Sutras 23-28); text detail only

by_area.personality: Intelligent, forgiving (Bhrigu Sutras 23-28); polished manners (Raman); comfort achieved rather than only wanted (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Land, interiors, real estate, hospitality (PanchangBodh); a bright career as an artist when well fortified (Raman).
by_area.finance: Rich (Saravali 30.65); gold and conveyances with a strong 4th lord (Bhrigu Sutras 23-28).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Raman); risk of extra-marital ties if the 4th lord is afflicted (Bhrigu Sutras 28).
by_area.family: Deep attachment to the mother (Raman); warm mother bond (PanchangBodh); concord at home (Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Religiously inclined (Raman).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Directional strength (digbala) in the 4th, its strongest house (PanchangBodh)
Strong 4th lord: horses, palanquins, gold (Bhrigu Sutras 27)
Well fortified: a great asset; artistic career (Raman)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
4th lord with a malefic, in an enemy or debilitated sign, or weak: no land or vehicles, distress to mother (Bhrigu Sutras 28)
Afflicted: loose morals and misuse of artistic talent (Raman)
Staying in a comfortable arrangement after it stops growing (PanchangBodh)
placement_entries.disagreements: Jataka Parijata 8.69 alone adds domination by the spouse. Bhrigu Sutras 28 links an afflicted 4th lord to distress for the mother, which its commentator questions for a benefic Venus.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a beautiful, comfortable home and close bond with the mother. Treat property and vehicles as traditional indications, not promises.

placement_entries.summary: Venus in Cancer (Karka), the Moon's water sign and an enemy's sign for Venus, gives emotional, gentle and nurturing affection with comfort and good character, but classical texts warn of emotional turbulence, indulgence and recurring domestic difficulties.
common_outcomes: Gentle, wise, virtuous and good-looking
Gets the comforts desired
Strong emotional needs in relationships
Recurring family or domestic difficulties
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.16: two marriages, timidity and sorrow through desire
Saravali mentions trouble through relationships and drink

by_area.personality: Saravali 28.7-8: wise, virtuous, soft and just. Brihat Jataka 18.16 (Sastri): timid but very arrogant.
by_area.career: Saravali 28.7-8: chief among men.
by_area.finance: Saravali: desired happiness and wealth. Brihat Jataka 18.16 (Sastri): seeks monetary help from others.
by_area.relationships: Classical texts warn of turbulence: troubles through women (Saravali) and, in Brihat Jataka, two marriages.
by_area.family: Recurring family difficulties (Saravali).

strengtheners: Saravali 28.43-48: Sun's aspect gives a dutiful spouse of good family and wealth; Moon's aspect gives happiness, children and beauty; Mars' aspect gives artistic skill, wealth and fortune; Jupiter's aspect gives servants, children, friends and favour from authorities
James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (navamsa section): a vargottama planet gives results like a planet in its own sign
weakeners_or_cancellations: Enemy's sign (Phaladeepika 3.19: 'distressed'); Braha: the Moon is Venus' enemy and Venus is not welcomed in its sign
Saravali 28.43-48: Saturn's aspect brings domination by partner, poverty and unhappiness; Mercury's aspect, troubles through relatives and wandering

James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (Sun and 'Combustion' sections): a planet within about 8 degrees of the Sun is combust and its significations and the houses it rules are spoiled
placement_entries.disagreements: Saravali gives a fairly positive character picture with domestic difficulties; Brihat Jataka is more negative in both translations, focusing on two marriages, timidity and misery.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a warm, nurturing heart with strong emotional needs. Never predict divorce or remarriage; frame as the importance of emotional security. Avoid any statement about drinking.

placement_entries.summary: Saturn in the 2nd strains early finances, family warmth and speech, with several texts promising wealth and comforts later, often away from the native place; for lagnas where Saturn is a functional benefic the financial picture is reversed.
common_outcomes: Money comes slowly and with much work (Raman HJH; Braha; Bhrigu Sutras 8-9)
Harsh or reserved speech; unsocial manner (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Unattractive or afflicted face, or mouth/eye complaints (Phaladeepika 8.21; Saravali 30.75; Bhrigu Sutras 8-9; Braha)
Wealth, vehicles and comforts later in life, often after moving away or abroad (Phaladeepika 8.21; Saravali 30.75; Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka (Sun's 2nd-house result applied to Saturn): immensely rich but deprived of wealth by the ruler
Bhrigu Sutras 8-9: two marriages; with a malefic, misconduct with women and charge of a religious institution (matha); no lands
Gains through metals, storage, mines and labour (Raman HJH); coal, wood, metal, mining (Braha)

by_area.personality: Harsh in speech, unsocial and sorrowful, coming across many opportunities but seldom taking them (Raman HJH).
by_area.career: Gain by dealing with metals, storage, mines or labour (Raman HJH); hard-labour trades (Braha).
by_area.finance: Earning is an uphill struggle, much work for little gain, unless the 2nd is Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius (Raman HJH); financial stringency (Bhrigu Sutras 8-9); later accumulation (Phaladeepika 8.21; Saravali 30.75).
by_area.health: Eye trouble (Bhrigu Sutras 8-9); right-eye, mouth, teeth or gum complaints (Braha); disease of the face (Brihat Jataka via 20.1).
by_area.relationships: Bhrigu Sutras 8-9 speaks of two marriages; Hindu Predictive Astrology also lists two wives.
by_area.family: Unhappy family life (Raman HJH; Braha); 'devoid of his own men' (Saravali 30.75).

strengtheners: Saturn in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius in the 2nd: slow but steady wealth, learning, dedication to family (Raman HJH; Braha)
Lagnas where Saturn rules good houses: Aries, Taurus, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn (Bhrigu Sutras commentary); Libra, Virgo, Taurus, Capricorn (Braha)
Saturn lord of a good house in the 2nd lets the late-life prosperity of Phaladeepika/Saravali materialise (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saturn in Aries in the 2nd: poverty, hard or deceitful work, disturbed family, eye defect (Braha)
Association with a malefic (Bhrigu Sutras 8-9)
placement_entries.disagreements: Brihat Jataka (via the Sun rule) makes the native very rich though wealth is taken by the ruler, and Saravali says he 'enjoys worldly prosperity', whereas Phaladeepika, Bhrigu Sutras, Raman and Braha describe early poverty or uphill earning. Most agree on later or foreign gains. Raman excepts Libra/Capricorn/Aquarius in the 2nd; Braha and the Bhrigu Sutras commentator except whole lagnas instead.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe money as built slowly through persistence, with improvement later in life or after relocation. Speak of measured, careful speech rather than 'harsh' speech. Do not predict two marriages; mention family responsibilities gently.

placement_entries.summary: Saturn in Taurus sits in the sign of its friend Venus. Classical texts describe a serving or dependent position, modest means and attraction to pleasure, while Raman's modern list adds success, cleverness and self-restraint, and his dasa note speaks of good income.
common_outcomes: Service or dependent work and many assignments (Saravali 29.3-4)
Strong attraction to partners and pleasure (Saravali 29.3-4; Brihat Jataka 18.18)
Raman lists success, power, cleverness, persuasiveness, love of solitude and self-restraint (HPA ch.22)
Raman's dasa note: gains from land and agriculture and good income (HPA ch.24)
rare_outcomes: Brihat Jataka 18.18 mentions limited power and several marriages

Saravali 29.32: Moon aspect brings wealth through women and honour from ministers; 29.35: Jupiter aspect makes one liked, charitable and industrious; 29.36: Venus aspect brings gems, strength and royal favour
Saravali 29.31: Sun aspect makes one learned but losing wealth

by_area.personality: Raman: clever, persuasive, likes solitude, self-restrained but a worrier (HPA ch.22).
by_area.career: Service and many assignments (Saravali 29.3-4); agriculture and land gains in Saturn's dasa (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.finance: Saravali 29.3-4 says bereft of wealth; Raman's dasa note gives great income (HPA ch.24); benefic aspects improve wealth (Saravali 29.32, 29.36).
by_area.relationships: Classical texts flag attraction to women and several unions (Saravali 29.3-4; Brihat Jataka 18.18).

strengtheners: Venus is Saturn's friend (Braha; Bhavartha Ratnakara 15.7 lists Taurus as friendly for Saturn)
Moon, Jupiter or Venus aspecting Saturn (Saravali 29.32, 29.35, 29.36)
Phaladeepika 9.16: a planet in a friend's sign brings success through friends and support
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mercury aspect is described as weakening and base (Saravali 29.34)
Sun aspect costs wealth (Saravali 29.31)
placement_entries.disagreements: Saravali calls the native poor; Raman's sign list calls him successful and powerful and his dasa note promises income. The friendly-sign rule (Phaladeepika, Bhavartha Ratnakara, Braha) supports the more favourable reading.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Emphasise patient building of security and the need for discipline with comfort. Do not predict infidelity or multiple marriages; say relationships benefit from clear commitments.

placement_entries.summary: Rahu in the 3rd, an upachaya house, is one of its best placements: courage, initiative, strong will, wealth and long life, at the cost of harmony with siblings.
common_outcomes: Courageous, bold, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Wealth and long life (Phaladeepika 8.25; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Strained relations with, or few, siblings (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Braha)
Fulfilment of efforts and desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Abundance of oilseeds/produce (Bhrigu Sutras 7-8); with a benefic, a mark on the neck
Severe criticism for one's views; sudden, unexpected news (Raman HJH)
Gymnastic or physical skill; many relations (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Talent in organising, writing, music or drama (Braha)

by_area.personality: Proud, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25); 'brave for outward appearances' (Raman HJH); adventurous, excited, motivated (Braha).
by_area.career: Ability in organisational or detail work, communication, fine arts; Gemini/Virgo may give work as a producer or director (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.25); very wealthy (Hindu Predictive Astrology); favours wealth and respect (Braha).
by_area.health: Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha).
by_area.family: Hostile to brothers (Phaladeepika 8.25); generally bad for brothers (Raman HJH); few younger siblings or no happiness from them (Braha); few children (Hindu Predictive Astrology).

strengtheners: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics destroys all evils (Saravali 12.3-5); counteracts other negative combinations (Raman HJH)
Malefics in upachaya houses give good results (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: greater courage, artistic and communicative excellence (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Bhrigu Sutras 7-8 gives only a neutral or minor result, so the strong positive reading rests on Phaladeepika and later authors
Sibling matters remain the weak point even when Rahu is strong (Braha)
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika, Raman, Braha and Saravali 12 agree that the 3rd is good for Rahu; the Bhrigu Sutras give only a minor material result. Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 omits the 3rd from Rahu's good houses.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: A confident placement to describe: initiative, nerve and success through one's own efforts and communication. Mention sibling relationships as needing care, without predicting estrangement.
