placement_entries.summary: Gemini is Rahu's exaltation in one major school (Jataka Bharanam's main view, Sanjay Rath; 'others' per Foss) and its moolatrikona in Bhavartha Ratnakara; Braha calls Mercury's signs the only agreed strong signs for the nodes. Foss sees Gemini as Rahu's peak for worldly affairs and debate. Raman's dasa note, however, is unfavourable.
common_outcomes: Love of debate and counter-argument; peak worldly effect per some scholars (Foss, name 2)
Honour, fame, leadership and wealth when Rahu in Gemini is rising (Braha)
Raman's dasa note: more enemies, short temper, fear of authorities and disfavour (HPA ch.24)
Fast learning and communication skill (astromedha.in, via summary)
rare_outcomes: Jataka Bharanam reports 20 degrees of Gemini as Rahu's highest exaltation point in one opinion
Foss: one text says Rahu in Gemini in the 1st house removes all afflictions (name 64)
BPHS 45.123 lists Gemini among signs where Rahu gives wealth even in the sleeping state

by_area.personality: Argumentative, quick, always with a counter-argument (Foss, name 2).
by_area.career: Braha: in Gemini or Virgo in the 10th or other houses, the nodes flourish; communication fields (astromedha.in, via summary).
by_area.finance: Wealth even in a weak state (BPHS 45.123).

strengtheners: Strong Mercury (dispositor; Rahu's friend per Braha)
Rahu rising in Gemini (Foss, name 64; Braha)
Braha: the nodes do better in the 3rd, 6th, 10th and 11th houses; Frawley: Rahu works best in the 9th or 10th with that house's ruler strong
weakeners_or_cancellations: Afflicted or combust Mercury (Frawley pp.256-257)
Under the Taurus school Gemini is only a friendly sign or moolatrikona (Raman; Bhavartha Ratnakara 15.8)
placement_entries.disagreements: Exaltation (Jataka Bharanam main view, Rath, 'others' per Foss), moolatrikona (Bhavartha Ratnakara 15.8), agreed strong sign for both nodes (Braha), or only friendly under the Taurus school (Raman). Raman's dasa note is negative even though most schools rate Gemini highly.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Highlight quick intelligence and communication skill; mention restlessness gently. State that traditions differ on Rahu's dignity here.

placement_entries.summary: Ketu in the 9th is classically adverse for fortune, righteousness and the father; modern readings add short temper and haughtiness but also valour, thrift and a good spouse, with fortune restored when Ketu is well placed.
common_outcomes: Misfortune or ill luck (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha)
Strain with or loss of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32; Braha); poor treatment of parents (Raman HJH)
Unrighteous conduct or slandering the good in classical lists (Phaladeepika 8.32; Bhrigu Sutras 24; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Foss name 57)
Little interest in philosophy or religion (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Wealth earned with the help of foreigners; anxious for children (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Good spouse and children; many children (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Eloquent, valorous, fond of pomp; saves money through frugality (Raman HJH)
Bhrigu Sutras 24: childless, dependent livelihood

by_area.personality: Short-tempered, upset by trifles, haughty but valorous, eloquent (Raman HJH); narrow-minded (Braha); untruthful, thrifty (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.finance: Indigent (Phaladeepika 8.32); frugal and saves much (Raman HJH); wealth via foreigners (Chamatkar Chintamani).
by_area.health: Short-sighted (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.relationships: Good wife (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.family: Deprived of the father (Phaladeepika 8.32); hostile to parents (Raman HJH); difficulties with a father whose life may be troubled (Braha); good children (Raman HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Foss: Ketu here may indicate religious extremism or experiencing 'papa' (demerit), though he softens the term.

strengtheners: Ketu in Gemini or Virgo: benefit from a fine father, luck, good morals (Braha)
Trikona placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52)
Node in the 9th or 10th with a trikona lord gives prosperity (Uttara Kalamrita, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Node in a trikona associated with the 2nd or 7th lord: harmful dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
placement_entries.disagreements: Classical support for Ketu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no node results by house; Phaladeepika 8.28-33 is the main classical per-house statement, the Bhrigu Sutras give a single combined result for Rahu or Ketu, and the rest are scattered rules (Uttara Kalamrita, BPHS, Jataka Parijata) or later/modern readings. Raman HJH and Hindu Predictive Astrology give a good spouse and (many) children, while the Bhrigu Sutras give childlessness; Chamatkar Chintamani is mildly positive financially.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe an independent, sometimes sceptical relationship with tradition, teachers and the father, and a fortune built through one's own choices. Avoid moral judgments and statements about the father's death.

placement_entries.summary: Sagittarius is Ketu's exaltation in one teacher's view in Jataka Bharanam and, per Wikipedia, among most modern astrologers; Bhavartha Ratnakara calls it Ketu's moolatrikona, while Jatakalankaram (as reported) makes it the debilitation. Raman's dasa note is among his best for Ketu: harmony, education, religious discussion and moral elevation.
common_outcomes: Raman's dasa note: domestic harmony, favour of the eminent, progress in education, religious discussion, moral elevation, tolerance (HPA ch.24)
Clear, intuitive grasp of philosophy; teaching without ego (astromedha.in, via summary)
rare_outcomes: Jatakalankaram (via summary): debilitation in Sagittarius
Jataka Bharanam: one teacher puts Ketu's highest exaltation at 6 degrees of Sagittarius

by_area.family: Domestic harmony and happiness in Ketu's dasa (Raman HPA ch.24).
by_area.spirituality: Religious discussion, moral elevation and tolerance (Raman HPA ch.24).

strengtheners: Strong Jupiter (dispositor; Frawley p.258); Sagittarius is a benefic's sign, favourable for the nodes per Raman (HPA ch.15)
Frawley: Ketu in the 12th unafflicted is strong (p.259)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Weak or afflicted Jupiter (Frawley p.258)
placement_entries.disagreements: Exaltation (one teacher in Jataka Bharanam, modern majority per Wikipedia) vs moolatrikona (Bhavartha Ratnakara) vs debilitation (Jatakalankaram) vs neutral (Scorpio school). Raman's dasa note is favourable.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe a natural seeker with clear insight; state that traditions differ on dignity. Do not discourage formal study.

placement_entries.summary: One of the best placements: the self joins fortune, dharma and the guru. The person is lucky, well-liked, devout, eloquent and blessed with family and wealth.
common_outcomes: good fortune and support from elders, teachers and father
religious or philosophical nature
eloquence and skill
happiness through spouse, children and wealth
rare_outcomes: BPHS specifically: devotion to Vishnu

by_area.personality: Fortunate, principled, beloved by people (BPHS 24.9); protector of others and a good orator (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.finance: Rich (Raman; BPHS 24.9; Rath 4.4.9); if well disposed, inherits good ancestral and paternal property (Raman).
by_area.relationships: Happiness through spouse and children (BPHS 24.9; Raman).
by_area.family: If well disposed, the father is famous, philanthropic and god-fearing (Raman); happy family (Rath 4.4.9).
by_area.spirituality: Religious; traditional mention of devotion to Vishnu (BPHS 24.9; Raman; Charak; Rath).

strengtheners: exaltation: Leo lagna (Sun in Aries) and Aquarius lagna (Saturn in Libra)
Jupiter aspect, strong 9th lord
lagna lord and 9th lord connected (classical raja yoga)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Scorpio lagna, Mars in Cancer
combustion, malefic affliction, papakartari on the 9th
placement_entries.disagreements: None significant; all classical and modern sources agree.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Describe as a fortunate, principled placement. Phrase devotion generally (spiritual or philosophical leaning) rather than naming a deity unless the user's tradition calls for it.

placement_entries.summary: Wealth joins home, property and comforts: a broadly prosperous placement; exaltation plus Jupiter's company is said to give near-royal status.
common_outcomes: gains of all kinds, often through land, home or vehicles
comfortable domestic life
family wealth connected with the mother
rare_outcomes: BPHS: if exalted and with Jupiter, king-like status

by_area.personality: Truthful (Charak); spends on own comfort yet frugal with money (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.career: If fortified: earnings as a vehicle dealer or agent, agriculturist, landlord or commission agent (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.finance: Prosperous in every way (BPHS 24.16); kendra placement supports wealth (BPHS 13.1); king-like if exalted with Jupiter (BPHS 24.16; Charak adds Venus).
by_area.family: Benefits from maternal relations, with losses through them if the 4th lord is afflicted (Raman); benefits from father (Charak).

strengtheners: exaltation: Libra lagna, Mars in Capricorn
conjunction with Jupiter while exalted (BPHS 24.16)
connection with the 11th lord (BPHS 13.4)
2nd lord with Jupiter in a kendra or trikona: learned and publicly honoured (Bhavartha Ratnakara II, Education st. 8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Cancer lagna (Sun in Libra) and Capricorn lagna (Saturn in Aries)
malefic affliction to the 4th or Moon
placement_entries.disagreements: Raman's fortified results (vehicles, land, agriculture) and Charak's 'benefits from father' extend BPHS without conflicting with it.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Present as comfort and property-linked prosperity; avoid promising royal status.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of siblings and effort in the house of conflict: friction with siblings and maternal uncles, yet considerable wealth and competitive drive.
common_outcomes: disagreements or rivalry with siblings
strong competitive or fighting spirit
wealth through service, competition or litigation
rare_outcomes: BPHS: enmity with maternal uncle, but affection from maternal aunt (ELS rendering)
Raman: accepting illegal gratification (traditional)

by_area.personality: Determined in conflict (BPHS 24.30); Rath 6.4: the 3rd lord in a dusthana keeps impulses under control.
by_area.career: With the 6th lord in the 3rd at the same time (exchange), sport, physical culture or athletics (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.finance: Very wealthy (BPHS 24.30; Raman: becomes rich; Charak: very rich); Rath: sudden gains through conquest or competition.
by_area.health: Charak lists eye trouble and sickliness, and Raman disease when both houses are afflicted (traditional); no medical claims.
by_area.family: Sibling and maternal-relative tensions (BPHS 24.30; Raman; Charak). If well disposed, a younger sibling may join the army or a sibling become a physician (Raman). Bhavartha Ratnakara III st. 6 and 10 carry a traditional line about loss of brothers (late in life if benefics are there); never predict.

strengtheners: own sign: Aries lagna (Mercury in Virgo, also exalted and 6th lord) and Libra lagna (Jupiter in Pisces, also 6th lord)
strong malefic in the 6th fights obstacles well (Phaladeepika 15.7)
3rd lord joined by other dusthana lords here: viparita rajayoga (Rath, Crux 6.4)
6th lord in the 3rd at the same time: sportsman or athlete (Raman HTJH I)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation: Scorpio lagna (Saturn in Aries) and Aquarius lagna (Mars in Cancer)
malefic affliction increases conflict
3rd and 6th both afflicted: illness, enemies and deceit (Raman HTJH I)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman, Charak and Bhavartha Ratnakara stress friction with or loss of siblings; Rath reads the 3rd lord in a dusthana as auspicious. All agree on wealth. The ELS rendering includes the maternal-aunt line, as does Charak.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Mention possible sibling disagreements as something to manage and highlight competitive strength and earnings. Avoid predicting estrangement.

placement_entries.summary: Home and comforts link with gains: the person is generous, virtuous and charitable, helps others and can gain through property or vehicles; BPHS adds a traditional caution about hidden ailments.
common_outcomes: gains through land, property or vehicles (Raman; BPHS 15.13)
generous and helpful
charitable nature
rare_outcomes: BPHS traditional view: fear of a hidden or secret illness
BPHS 15.13: 4th lord with the 11th lord (or 11th lord in the 4th) brings a vehicle

by_area.personality: Generous, virtuous, self-made (BPHS 24.47; Raman; Charak: talented, helpful).
by_area.career: Success in buying and selling land and cattle (Raman HTJH I).
by_area.finance: Gains through land trade (Raman); a vehicle when linked with the 11th lord (BPHS 15.13).
by_area.health: BPHS (fear of hidden illness), Raman and Charak (sickly) carry traditional lines; do not make medical predictions.
by_area.family: Mother fortunate (Raman); devoted to the father (Charak); Raman adds a possible step-mother (traditional).
by_area.spirituality: Charity and helping others (BPHS 24.47; Charak).

strengtheners: own sign: Cancer lagna (Venus in Taurus, also 11th lord) and Capricorn lagna (Mars in Scorpio, also 11th lord)
exaltation: Virgo lagna, Jupiter in Cancer
conjunction with the 11th lord (BPHS 15.13)
exchange of the 4th and 11th lords: Bhagyavahana yoga (Bhavartha Ratnakara IV st. 11)
Venus as 4th lord here (Cancer lagna, own sign): many conveyances (Bhavartha Ratnakara IV st. 5)
joined or aspected by Saturn: conveyances in Saturn's periods (Bhavartha Ratnakara VIII st. 7-8)
4th lord in an upachaya (3rd, 6th, 10th, 11th) grows the 4th house, especially if vargottama or joined or aspected by a trine lord (Rath, Crux 7.3.1)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction or combustion
placement_entries.disagreements: Sources agree on generosity, charity and gains; all three (BPHS, Raman, Charak) add a health caution in different forms. Modern sources emphasise property income.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Positive about generosity and gains. Omit the illness line or present it only as a traditional note to look after wellbeing.

placement_entries.summary: The 5th lord in its own house strengthens intelligence, merit and the house of children. BPHS and Phaladeepika make the children result depend on benefic influence; Raman and Braha add mantra, mathematics and leadership of religious bodies.
common_outcomes: Highly intelligent, virtuous and dear to friends (BPHS 24.53; Braha)
Children when benefics influence the lord (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9); Raman: a number of sons when favourable
Great in one's own field; expertise in mantra, mathematics or scripture (Raman; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Raman and Braha: may head a religious or spiritual institution
Braha: interest in politics or rulership; successful investments and speculation
Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.16 and 9.19: the 5th lord in the 5th together with the 4th lord in the 4th gives fortune and vehicles, and with the 10th lord in the 10th gives power and fame
Bhavartha Ratnakara (ch. XI st. 5): 5th, 7th and 9th lords in their own houses give holy dips during their periods
Raman, afflicted: concerns for children, not keeping one's word, wavering mind, cruelty (traditional view)

by_area.personality: Virtuous and dear to friends (BPHS 24.53); integrity and merit (Braha). Raman: wavering and unreliable if afflicted.
by_area.career: Raman: becomes great in his own line; expert in mantra shastra or mathematics; befriends the powerful. Braha: may be a ruler or politician.
by_area.finance: Braha: successful investments and a liking for speculation.
by_area.relationships: Braha: happy love affairs.
by_area.family: Children if benefics are involved, none or grief if malefics (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9); Raman: a number of sons when favourable.
by_area.spirituality: Knowledge of mantras or scriptures, religious-minded, strong past merit (Braha); expert in mantra shastra, may head a religious institution (Raman).

strengtheners: Benefic aspect or conjunction on the lord (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9)
The 4th lord in the 4th or the 10th lord in the 10th at the same time (Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.16, 9.19)
Jupiter joining or aspecting the 5th lord (Bhavartha Ratnakara 4.19: birth of children is indicated)
The 5th lord a benefic and aspected by a benefic or placed in a benefic sign (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 231 Buddhimaturya: intelligence and good character)
The 5th lord well placed and in a vaiseshikamsa (Phaladeepika 16.15: intelligent and open-hearted)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Malefic aspect or conjunction with no benefic aspect (BPHS 24.53; Phaladeepika 12.9: loss of children)
Raman: an afflicted lord gives contrary results
When Jupiter, the natural significator of children, is itself the 5th lord in the 5th, the 'karaka in its own bhava harms it' dictum is sometimes applied; see disagreements
placement_entries.disagreements: Karaka debate: Bhavartha Ratnakara repeats the dictum that Jupiter in the 5th harms children (relevant when Jupiter is the 5th lord for Leo or Scorpio), but its translator Raman disagrees from experience and limits the harm to affliction by Mars, Saturn or Rahu. On the core placement, BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha agree that benefic or malefic influence decides the children result.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Lead with intelligence, integrity and creative or spiritual gifts. Say children prospects depend on other factors in the chart; never predict childlessness.

placement_entries.summary: The 6th lord in its own house. Phaladeepika calls it Harsha yoga (happiness, health, victory over enemies); BPHS gives enmity with kin but friendship with outsiders; Braha is favourable; Raman, in 300 Combinations, says that in practice the evil of the 6th lordship is only modified, not removed.
common_outcomes: Overcomes enemies and competitors (Phaladeepika 6.63; Braha)
Friction with one's own kin but good relations with outsiders (BPHS 24.66; Raman, 300 Combinations remarks)
Benefits from cousins and the maternal uncle, who may be prominent (Raman; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 6.63 Harsha yoga: happiness, good fortune, a strong constitution, aversion to sin, friendship with eminent people, wealth, fame and sons
Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope: with a weak lagna lord, a lasting illness and enmity with kin (traditional view)
Raman p. 136: the 6th lord in the 6th with Mars, aspected by Rahu or Ketu, is listed for loss of estates by auction
Braha: healthy, good job, good workers, interest in medicine

by_area.personality: Phaladeepika 6.63: afraid of sinful deeds, invincible. BPHS 24.66: friendly to outsiders.
by_area.career: Braha: good job and good servants or workers; interest in medicine or healing.
by_area.finance: Mediocre wealth (BPHS 24.66); wealthy (Braha; Phaladeepika 6.63).
by_area.health: Strong constitution (Phaladeepika 6.63; Braha). Raman: a weak lagna lord with this placement is a traditional caution.
by_area.relationships: Enmity with one's own kin, friendship with others (BPHS 24.66); friends among the eminent (Phaladeepika 6.63).
by_area.family: Increase of cousins and a famous maternal uncle (Raman; Braha).

strengtheners: A strong lagna lord (Raman: the harsh result is tied to a weak lagna lord)
The 6th lord in a dusthana and debilitated, in an enemy sign or combust, with a stronger lagna lord (Phaladeepika 16.18: destruction of enemies)
The lagna lord stronger than the 6th lord, in a benefic's sign or amsa and aspected by a benefic (Phaladeepika 16.17: health and comfort)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Conjunction with a weak lagna lord (Raman: lasting illness and enmity with kin)
With Mars and aspected by Rahu or Ketu (Raman p. 136)
Raman, 300 Combinations no. 105: judge by 'the intrinsic evil nature of the ownership'
placement_entries.disagreements: Phaladeepika 6.57 counts the 6th lord in the 6th as Harsha yoga and Raman's own definition (6th, 8th and 12th lords in the 6th, 8th and 12th) includes it; an earlier note in this file, taken from a practitioner summary, wrongly said Raman excludes it. Raman nevertheless reports that in practice the results are often contrary and the evil is only modified. BPHS 24.66 is mixed, Braha and Phaladeepika favourable.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame as strong resilience and the ability to beat obstacles. Mention family friction gently; no health predictions.

placement_entries.summary: Two kendras linked: marriage joins home, comfort and education. Raman, Braha and Rath read a happy marriage, comforts, vehicles and education; BPHS gives a truthful, intelligent, religious native with an independent-minded spouse.
common_outcomes: Happy marriage and a lucky partner (Raman; Braha); loves spouse and family (Rath)
Comforts, homes, land and vehicles (Raman; Braha)
High academic qualifications (Raman; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.76: the spouse is not under the native's control; dental complaints (traditional notes)
Raman, afflicted: an immature partner spoils domestic harmony; problems with conveyances
Braha: desire for moksha
Bhavartha Ratnakara 6.12: the 7th, 2nd and 10th lords together in the 4th are listed for extra-marital attachment (traditional view)

by_area.personality: Truthful, intelligent and religious (BPHS 24.76).
by_area.finance: Comforts and many vehicles (Raman); land, homes and conveyances (Braha).
by_area.health: BPHS 24.76: dental complaints (traditional note only).
by_area.relationships: Happy married life with a lucky partner and many children (Raman); loves spouse and family (Rath); an independent spouse (BPHS 24.76).
by_area.family: Raman: many children.
by_area.spirituality: Religious (BPHS 24.76); desire for moksha (Braha).

strengtheners: The 7th lord or Venus joined or aspected by Jupiter or Mercury (Raman, 300 Combinations no. 239 Satkalatra: a noble, virtuous spouse)
The 7th house linked with a benefic and its lord strong (Phaladeepika 16.20: a virtuous spouse, happy marriage, children)
The 7th lord with Venus and free of malefic aspect or conjunction (Bhavartha Ratnakara 6.1: one marriage)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Raman: affliction spoils domestic harmony; heavy affliction by the nodes and malefics questions the spouse's conduct
7th, 2nd and 10th lords together in the 4th (Bhavartha Ratnakara 6.12)
Raman: the results must not be applied literally without judging the whole chart and the strength of every planet (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 171)
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Translate 'wife not under control' into a respectful 'an independent-minded partner'. No medical claims.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of upheaval in the house of fortune, father and dharma. BPHS, Raman and Braha read strain on fortune, faith and the father; Bhavartha Ratnakara gives a notable counter-rule: when the 8th and 9th lords join or aspect, fame and power come in the 8th lord's period.
common_outcomes: Strained relations with the father, or a father who has a hard life (Raman; Braha)
Fortune and luck spoiled or delayed (Braha); little regard for religion (BPHS 24.93; Braha)
Long-lived (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.93: betrays religion, heterodox, a difficult spouse, takes others' wealth (traditional view)
Raman: with malefics, loss of paternal property; with benefics, acquires paternal property and harmony with the father
Bhavartha Ratnakara 8.9-8.10: 8th and 9th lords conjunct or in mutual aspect confer fame and power in the 8th lord's dasa or sub-period
Raman: a weak 9th lord here adds hardship, deserting friends and fault-finding superiors

by_area.personality: Heterodox (BPHS 24.93); no faith or appreciation of philosophy (Braha). Traditional views.
by_area.career: Raman: superiors find fault when the 9th lord is weak.
by_area.finance: Loss of paternal property with malefics, gain of it with benefics (Raman).
by_area.relationships: BPHS 24.93: a wicked spouse (traditional view); Raman: friends and kin may desert if the 9th lord is weak.
by_area.family: Misunderstandings with the father (Raman); bad relations with the father (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: No gains from elders or gurus; bhagya spoiled (Braha). Bhavartha Ratnakara's fame yoga is the main counter-view.

strengtheners: Benefics joining (Raman: paternal property gained, harmony with the father)
The 8th lord conjoined with or aspected by the 9th lord (Bhavartha Ratnakara 8.9-8.10: fame and power in the 8th lord's period)
The 8th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna (Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope pp. 206-207: the evil is greatly reduced)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Malefics joining (Raman: loss of paternal property)
A weak 9th lord (Raman: hardships)
Raman: an 8th lord fortified in a kendra or trikona intensifies its evil results (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 206)
Phaladeepika 15.5: a house occupied by the lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th suffers, unless a benefic aspects it

Raman: results must be modified by the strength of the lagna, the Moon and the running dasha; for indications of wrong conduct, a strong lagna, Moon and 10th mean the temptation is overcome (How to Judge a Horoscope p. 207)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha are mainly unfavourable; Bhavartha Ratnakara 8.9-8.10 gives fame and power when the 8th and 9th lords are linked. The earlier 'unconventional spirituality' reading was not supported by any source read and has been removed.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: No moral judgements. Frame as fortune that comes through change and a searching, independent spiritual outlook.

placement_entries.summary: Fortune works through effort, communication, siblings and travel. BPHS and Braha see happiness from siblings; Raman says fortune is made through writing and speaking.
common_outcomes: happiness from siblings (BPHS 24.99; Braha)
fortune made through writing, speeches and oratory (Raman HTJH)
advances fortune with the help of siblings (Raman HTJH)
many short and long journeys (Braha)
talent in music, dance, drama or literature (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Rath reads the 9th lord in the 3rd harshly for the father's conduct and calls the native passionate (Crux 6.5, 12.9); a derived-house view, never to be used as a judgement of a parent
afflicted: trouble through one's writings, possibly forcing a sale of paternal property (Raman HTJH)

by_area.personality: Good character and virtuous (BPHS 24.99); courageous and adventurous (Braha).
by_area.career: Writing, speaking and oratory (Raman HTJH); literary talent, efforts succeed with ease (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.99); Raman says the father is of moderate means and the native advances his own fortune.
by_area.family: Siblings bring happiness and help fortune (BPHS 24.99; Raman HTJH); a sibling may be close to the father (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Lucky, religious and spiritual, as the 9th lord aspects its own house from here (Braha).

strengtheners: the 9th lord aspects its own 9th house from the 3rd, so 9th-house matters flourish (Braha)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction: trouble through irrational or offensive writing and loss of paternal property (Raman HTJH)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha are favourable on siblings, communication and effort. On the father they conflict: Braha calls him wealthy and long-lived, Raman of moderate means, and Rath reads his character negatively. Do not use the father lines.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Say fortune is activated by initiative, communication and siblings; avoid suggesting luck is 'lost'. Keep it encouraging about effort paying off.

placement_entries.summary: Career feeds wealth: the work of the person directly builds savings and family standing, and recognition from authorities is a classical theme.
common_outcomes: wealthy, virtuous, honoured by government (BPHS 24.110); fortunate, rises well and makes much money (Raman HTJH)
the family trade or family business as livelihood (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)
catering, restaurants or food business (Raman HTJH; Braha); hotel trade when the Moon influences the 10th lord (Rath Crux 13.4)
a good speaker; work may involve speaking, poetry or lecturing (Braha)
happiness from the father (BPHS 24.110)
rare_outcomes: Jataka Parijata (via summary) says the 10th lord in the 2nd gives exceptional fame
Simhasana yoga (10th lord in the 1st or 2nd): good results after middle age (Rath Crux 13.4)
afflicted: losses and winding up of the family business (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)

by_area.personality: Generous and virtuous (BPHS 24.110); truthful and charitable (Braha).
by_area.career: Family business, catering or restaurants (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4); speaking or lecturing (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.110); makes a lot of money (Raman HTJH); good earning ability, an artha lord in an artha house (Braha).
by_area.family: Develops the family trade (Raman HTJH); happiness from the father (BPHS 24.110); family happiness (Braha).

strengtheners: a strong Jupiter, significator of the family deity (Rath Crux 13.4)
strength scales the result (BPHS 24.145-148)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics afflicting the 10th lord or 10th: losses and closing of the family business (Raman HTJH; Rath Crux 13.4)
placement_entries.disagreements: None. Raman, Braha and Rath all add the family trade and food or catering businesses to BPHS's wealth and honour.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame as work that builds savings and family standing. Do not promise government honours.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of gains in the house of wealth: a classic dhana yoga, giving abundant wealth, accomplishment, generosity and happiness.
common_outcomes: abundant wealth; accomplished, generous, righteous and happy (BPHS 24.122)
earns through commerce and banking (Raman HTJH); banking or money-lending (Braha)
lives with or is helped by elder siblings (Raman HTJH; Braha)
gains by using family wealth or other assets (Rath Crux 14.8)
profitable business with friends (Raman HTJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.3: with the 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter linked, great gains
BPHS 22.9: exchange of 2nd and 11th lords gives great fortune after marriage
with the 2nd lord as well: large sums; with the 9th lord too, in exaltation or own vargas, a millionaire (Raman HTJH, combinations)
Frawley (Example Charts: Nelson Rockefeller, Virgo lagna): the Moon as 11th lord waxing in the 2nd house of income

by_area.personality: Generous, accomplished, righteous (BPHS 24.122); intelligent and a good speaker (Braha).
by_area.career: Commerce and banking (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: Abundant wealth (BPHS 24.122); several sources of income (Braha); family assets put to use (Rath Crux 14.8).
by_area.relationships: Exchange case links fortune to marriage (BPHS 22.9).
by_area.family: Lives with elder brothers: benefics give harmony, malefics domestic bickering (Raman HTJH); domestic happiness (Braha).

strengtheners: 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter associated (BPHS 22.3)
exchange with the 2nd lord (BPHS 22.9)
joined with the 2nd and 9th lords in exaltation or own vargas (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics joining: heavy losses on account of friends (Raman HTJH)
the 11th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna gives only moderate results (Raman HTJH)
placement_entries.disagreements: None on wealth. Raman adds that malefic company turns friends into a source of loss.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Frame as strong potential for savings and family prosperity. No guaranteed amounts; treat the 'after marriage' line as traditional.

placement_entries.summary: The lord of loss in the house of siblings and effort: BPHS says sibling happiness is limited and the person may be at odds with others and focused on self-care.
common_outcomes: lacks sibling happiness, hostile to others, attentive to own body (BPHS 24.135)
timid and quiet; spends on younger siblings (Raman HTJH)
little success as a writer; a commonplace job (Raman HTJH); no literary ability (Braha)
strong intuition (Braha)
rare_outcomes: with the 2nd lord here and Jupiter or the 9th lord aspecting: more than one marriage (Raman HTJH)
with the 3rd lord: mounting expenditure and many journeys in the period; joined instead with the 6th and 8th lords, good food, riches and luxuries (Raman HTJH, periods)
malefic affliction: ear trouble (Raman HTJH; Braha); a traditional line only

by_area.personality: Timid and quiet (Raman HTJH); hostile to others (BPHS 24.135); intuitive (Braha).
by_area.career: Commonplace work; unsuccessful as a writer (Raman HTJH).
by_area.finance: Spending on younger siblings (Raman HTJH).
by_area.family: Lacks sibling happiness (BPHS 24.135; Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association, own sign or exaltation (BPHS 23.1)
the 12th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, or aspected by benefics, reverses the bad results (Raman HTJH, periods)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction (Raman HTJH)
placement_entries.disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha agree on little sibling happiness and weak efforts; Braha alone adds strong intuition.
placement_entries.phrasing_guidance: Mention possible distance from siblings without implying conflict is fated. Encourage communication.
